# `dashboard/server.ts`

## Overview

Server-side utilities for the dashboard module. Provides helper functions for handling server requests and related operations.

---

## Functions

### `getRedirectUri`

Derives a redirect URI string from the provided request object.

> **Note:** This function is not directly exported from the module's public API.

```ts
import { getRedirectUri } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name  | Type      | Description                                      |
|-------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `req` | `Request` | The incoming request object used to build the redirect URI. |

#### Returns

`string` — The resolved redirect URI derived from the request.

#### Example

```ts
import { getRedirectUri } from '..'

const redirectUri = getRedirectUri(req)
// => "https://example.com/dashboard/callback"
```
